mapper.insert: INSERT INTO favorite_destination (fav_id, m_id, contentid, created_at) VALUES (seq_favorite_destination.NEXTVAL, #{mId}, #{contentid}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM favorite_destination WHERE m_id = #{mId} AND contentid = #{contentid}
mapper.select: SELECT f.fav_id AS favId, f.m_id AS mId, f.contentid, f.created_at AS createdAt, d.title, d.firstimage, d.addr1, d.contenttypeid FROM favorite_destination f JOIN destination d ON f.contentid = d.contentid WHERE f.m_id = #{mId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC

SELECT f.fav_id AS favId, f.m_id AS mId, f.contentid, f.created_at AS createdAt, d.title, d.firstimage, d.addr1 FROM favorite_destination f JOIN destination d ON f.contentid = d.contentid WHERE f.fav_id = #{favId}
